messages:
maya_ng: customer (tenant-42, eu-west) reports intermittent 502/504s from hosted API starting ~2026-03-18T12:33Z. errors spike right after we flipped a ratecap. sample trace id 6a1f2b
alex_k: can you paste the curl they used and one response header?
maya_ng: sample curl (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer redacted' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
```
response: `HTTP/2 502`
headers: `server: envoy`, `x-trace-id: 6a1f2b`, `via: midproxy`
sam_support: opened ticket RED-12345. customer measured ~30% 502, ~10% 504 for a 5k request batch. they included a small repro script that runs bursts of 200 concurrent requests.
jen_sre: quick hypothesis: config cutover caused sudden fanout (many requests) to authz service -> auth throttle -> upstreams returning 504 which frontdoor translates/propagates as 502. also seen keepalive / h2 stream resets in similar cases. need ingress + midproxy logs and a pcap to confirm.
alex_k: noting deploy bot: ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T12:34:56 by alex_k rolled ratecap-config v2 to eu-west
ops-bot: deployment note: ratecap-config v2 -> target shards eu-west, rollout 100% at 12:34:56 UTC
jen_sre: steps to repro locally (safe repro):
```
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Tenant: tenant-42' \
    https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}' &
done; wait
```
look for 502/504 pattern and matching trace-id in ingress logs. also capture: `kubectl -n ingress logs ingress-proxy-abc | grep 6a1f2b -A3` and `tcpdump -i any port 443 -w tenant42.pcap`
maya_ng: ran the local repro against a staging mirror, saw same ratio. envoy logs show `stream reset` followed by `upstream connect failure` and many `504 upstream request timeout` from auth cluster. attaching excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T12:34:59Z] ingress-proxy | trace=6a1f2b svc=ingress level=warn: stream reset: code=REFUSED_STREAM
[2026-03-18T12:35:01Z] midproxy     | trace=6a1f2b upstream=auth-1 svc=auth level=error: request timeout after 10s
[2026-03-18T12:35:02Z] midproxy     | trace=6a1f2b upstream=frontend svc=upstream level=error: received 504
```
sam_support: customer is asking for ETA, they're on EU paid plan, high impact. provided them a temporary workaround to reduce concurrent fanout from client side, but they need a platform fix.
jen_sre: mitigation options: rollback ratecap-config to v1 (undo cutover) OR enable auth cache fallback / increase auth cluster capacity / tune upstream timeout and circuit-breaker. short-term mitigation: enable a small backoff and retries (client-side) with jitter; server-side quick rollback easiest.
alex_k: starting rollback of ratecap-config v1 -> initiating now :thumbsup:
ops-bot: rollback started at 2026-03-18T12:38:10 by alex_k
maya_ng: customer confirms reduced errors after rollback (monitoring shows error-rate back to baseline). collecting full logs and pcap for postmortem attach.
jen_sre: follow-ups for postmortem: 1) ensure ratecap rollouts have canary gating for tenants with high fanout, 2) add alert on auth cluster 5xx/timeout tail during config flips, 3) harden midproxy to avoid translating upstream 504s into opaque 502s without payload, 4) add circuit breaker to limit simultaneous auth fanout.
sam_support: will draft postmortem and share with customer; leaving ticket open until 24h stable.
maya_ng: thanks team — rollback fixed customer impact. will attach repro script, logs, and pcap to RED-12345. :heart:
